name: Wingfire Blade
body:
Price 45,100 gp; Slot none; CL 8th; Weight 10 lbs.; Aura strong evocation, moderate transmutation

DESCRIPTION

This +2 flaming burst two-bladed sword has the hilt and blades modeled in red and yellow gold, finely wrought to give the impression of two spreaded wings. When used in combat, the blades appear to be wreathed in flame.

At will, the wielder of a wingfire blade can begin a spinning and whirling series of jumps, granting himself a +4 dodge bonus on AC. This ability lasts for 20 rounds per day. These rounds need not be consecutive.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 22,550 gp; Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells air walk, flame blade
